race.description: Goulburn Gbota Max 150 Points Final F
race.comment: MABEL'S WAY (6) is racing well without winning, recording four minors on end, the latest hitting the ground running with a fast early sectional but finishing in the minors again when second (22.79) over 400m at Bulli. Expecting another good run. GUS AND DODO (1) box seated before sticking on well to finish 0.8 lengths away in second (25.19) at this track in a Grade 5 over 440m. Goes well out of this box with a win and four minor placings. Winning chance. JACOBITE BATTLE (5) is a last-start placegetter who will have admirers. Something for the Multiples: SPRING SABALENKA (7)
